old_tree_summer.description: The same ancient tree in summer: the pale pink blossom becomes a full deep green leafy canopy in the game's summer greens. Keep the trunk, roots, branches, the canopy's outline and every pixel's position exactly the same; change only the colours as described. Stardew Valley pixel art.

old_tree_fall.description: The same ancient tree in autumn: the pale pink blossom becomes a canopy of shining GOLD leaves, warm gold and amber like gold leaf, glowing. Keep the trunk, roots, branches, the canopy's outline and every pixel's position exactly the same; change only the colours as described. Stardew Valley pixel art.

old_tree_winter.description: The same ancient tree in winter: bare branches with no leaves and no blossom, a light layer of white snow along the tops of the branches and the trunk. Keep the trunk, roots, branches, every pixel's position exactly the same; change only the colours as described. Stardew Valley pixel art.
